storage.built_in: 192 TB (256 TB raw) or 217 TB (288 TB raw) effective by model, RAID 60; OS on 2 x M.2 SSD, RAID 1

power.supply: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, auto-switching; dual redundant, hot-swappable

features: 2 x 10 GbE SFP+ ports in addition to the 4 x 1 GbE RJ-45 ports
